SUSHANT BOLISHETTY

Bengaluru, Karnataka (cid:127) +91-8880668686 (cid:127) sushantb6@gmail.com

SALES & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT | CORPORATE & B2B SALES

Results-driven Business Development and Sales professional with 3+ years of experience across Government & Defence procurement, automotive retail, corporate sales, and B2B business development. Experienced in corporate and fleet sales, leasing company relationships, IT/corporate accounts, client acquisition, negotiation, deal closure, sales pipeline management, and revenue growth. Proven ability to build strong client relationships and manage sales cycles from prospecting through closure.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Sigma AVIT Technology Solutions | Business Developer – Corporate, B2B & Government Sales | 01/2025 – Present | Bengaluru

(cid:127) Managed B2B corporate sales, engaging with IT companies and institutional clients to identify business requirements and

develop appropriate technology solutions.

(cid:127) Developed and maintained relationships with corporate decision-makers, IT teams, procurement teams, and key stakeholders. (cid:127) Handled the complete sales process, including lead generation, client meetings, requirement analysis, solution coordination,

commercial negotiation, and deal closure.

Identified new business opportunities within corporate accounts and expanded the customer pipeline through systematic prospecting and relationship management.

(cid:127) Collaborated with technical and delivery teams to prepare proposals and ensure solutions aligned with client requirements. (cid:127) Managed RFQs, tenders, proposals, pricing, negotiations, sales reporting, and pipeline reviews for business development

activities.

Focused on achieving sales targets, strengthening long-term corporate relationships, and generating repeat business opportunities.

Bellad TATA Motors (Passenger Car Division) | Customer Advisor – Sales & Operations | 10/2023 – 04/2025 | Bengaluru

(cid:127) Managed corporate and fleet sales activities, with a focus on corporate clients and leasing companies for vehicle requirements. (cid:127) Developed B2B opportunities with corporate accounts and leasing partners through prospecting, relationship building, and

corporate outreach.

(cid:127) Managed the end-to-end sales cycle from lead generation and understanding client requirements to commercial negotiation,

deal closure, invoicing, and delivery coordination.

(cid:127) Closed deals with corporate clients and leasing companies while coordinating with finance, insurance, service, and RTO teams

for smooth execution.

(cid:127) Consistently worked toward monthly sales targets and contributed to dealership revenue growth. (cid:127) Maintained strong customer relationships through proactive follow-up, post-sales support, and a focus on customer satisfaction. Elite Vintage Winery India Pvt. Ltd. | Trainee Marketing Manager (MBA Internship) | 01/2019 – 01/2020 | Mudhol

Supported marketing and brand promotion activities across distributor and retail networks.

Assisted in trade promotions, customer engagement campaigns, and market research to improve brand visibility and market reach.

EDUCATION

MBA / PGDM – Marketing | SVM-IMS Institute of Management, Bagalkot | 2018–2020 | GPA: 61.51%

BBA / BMS – Management | BVVS College, Bagalkot | 2013–2016 | GPA: 60.50%

CORE COMPETENCIES

Corporate Sales (cid:127) B2B Sales (cid:127) Key Account Management (cid:127) Fleet & Leasing Sales (cid:127) IT/Technology Sales (cid:127) Business Development (cid:127) Client Relationship Management (cid:127) Lead Generation (cid:127) Sales Pipeline Management (cid:127) Negotiation & Deal Closure (cid:127) Sales Target Achievement (cid:127) RFQ & Tender Management (cid:127) Proposal & Pricing (cid:127) Market Research (cid:127) Strategic Marketing (cid:127) Leadership & Team Building (cid:127) MS Office & CRM Tools
